purpose: Specify what an entry-model reviewer should inspect when a task requires complex sentence comprehension; numerical policies need corpus and learner evidence
dimensions: Exact source and text revision; selected teaching example versus complete passage
Top-level coordination, embedded coordination and combined structures separately
Matrix subject/predicate and nominal complement function, including formal versus real subject
Subordinate clause role, dependency scope and coordination boundaries
Relative antecedent and modifier attachment; reference distance and ambiguity
Nonfinite function and relation to finite clauses; form alone does not define difficulty
Quoted speaker versus narrator; temporal frame and reported obligation/opinion
Information relation: concession, condition, time, cause, result, example or restatement
Question demand: mark/classify/explain, retrieve, infer, paraphrase, combine or produce
Support and previous exposure: supplied underlines, strategy tip, wordbank, model, rereading, partner or dictionary
Genre and reader role; argument relation and source opinions distinct from empirical truth
Annotation and scoring evidence, independent adjudication and target-learner error/time outcomes
not_established: Universal word-count definition of long sentence
Required percentage by school grade or CEFR level
Normative maximum clause nesting depth or dependency distance
Difficulty from textbook unit number or number of conjunction tokens
Gold clause trees or exhaustive accepted rewritten answers
Production parser, entry-model implementation or learner calibration
sampling_requirements: Transcribe and independently verify complete passages before denominator-based statistics
Keep publisher-selected underlines as a separate sample selection class
Compare multiple genres, publishers, editions and relevant local cohort scopes
Annotate both successful and failed interpretations without inferring student results from AI
Freeze operational definitions and validate proposed thresholds with independent reviewers and actual learners
